title: Canonical chosen pullback of descent data
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $g:X'\to S$ and $h:X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $f\circ h=g$. Let $V\to X$ have descent datum $D$ relative to $f$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. The chosen fibre product $V\times_X X'$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with its second projection to $X'$, admits a descent datum $E$ relative to $g$ such that projection to $V$ intertwines the transport of $E$ with that of $D$ along $h$.

proof.text: Project points to V, transport using D, and pair with the new point in Xprime using the pullback universal property. This defines the transport of E.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_canonical_pullback_descent_datum {S X X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : X' ⟶ S) (h : X' ⟶ X) (hc : h ≫ f = g)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V) :
    ∃ E : Over.DescentDatum g (Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom h)),
      Over.DescentDatum.IsBaseChange hc (pullback.condition (f := V.hom) (g := h))
        D E
